title: CPF Module Schema: Application Insights Module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-applicationinsights'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

api_key_enabled.description: (Optional) Should api key created or skip as per input.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

application_type.description: (Required) Specifies the type of Application Insights to create. Changing this forces a new resource to be created

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

daily_data_cap_in_gb.description: (Optional) Specifies the Application Insights component daily data volume cap in GB.

daily_data_cap_notifications_disabled.description: (Optional) Specifies if a notification email will be send when the daily data volume cap is met.

disable_ip_masking.description: (Optional) Disables masking and log the real client IP.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

force_customer_storage_for_profiler.description: (Optional) Should the Application Insights component force users to create their own storage account for profiling?

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

internet_ingestion_enabled.description: (Optional) Should the Application Insights component support querying over the Public Internet?

internet_query_enabled.description: (Optional) Should the Application Insights component support querying over the Public Internet?

local_authentication_disabled.description: (Optional) Disable Non-Azure AD based Auth. Defaults to false.

read_permissions.description: (Optional) Specifies the list of read permissions granted to the API key. Valid values are agentconfig, aggregate, api, draft, extendqueries, search. Please note these values are case sensitive. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

retention_in_days.description: (Optional) Specifies the retention period in days.

sampling_percentage.description: (Optional) Specifies the percentage of the data produced by the monitored application that is sampled for Application Insights telemetry.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

uai_principal_id.description: (Required) Principal id of the User Assigned Identity which should be used be assigned the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role

workspace_id.description: (Optional) Specifies the id of a log analytics workspace resource

write_permissions.description: (Optional) Specifies the list of write permissions granted to the API key. Valid values are annotations. Please note these values are case sensitive. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

api_key.description: The api_key of the Application Insights.

id.description: The Resource ID of the Application Insights.

name.description: The Name of the Application Insights.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Applicationinsights' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
